CREATE TABLE plan_state (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	cursor UUID, 
	redo JSONB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE families (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	label VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	side VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	reserved_eligible BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	couple_children BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE guests (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	family_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100), 
	age INTEGER, 
	category VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	phone VARCHAR(40), 
	arrival DATE, 
	tags JSONB NOT NULL, 
	notes TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(family_id) REFERENCES families (id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_guests_family_id ON guests (family_id)

CREATE TABLE planning_resources (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	room_id VARCHAR(32), 
	staff_bed_id INTEGER, 
	reserved BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	near_restaurant BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	x FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	y FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(room_id) REFERENCES rooms (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(staff_bed_id) REFERENCES staff_beds (id)
)


CREATE TABLE assignments (
	guest_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	night DATE NOT NULL, 
	resource_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (guest_id, night), 
	FOREIGN KEY(guest_id) REFERENCES guests (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(resource_id) REFERENCES planning_resources (id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_assignments_resource_id ON assignments (resource_id)

CREATE TABLE room_locks (
	resource_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	night DATE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (resource_id, night), 
	FOREIGN KEY(resource_id) REFERENCES planning_resources (id)
)


CREATE TABLE guest_links (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	a UUID NOT NULL, 
	b UUID NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	severity VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(a) REFERENCES guests (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(b) REFERENCES guests (id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_guest_links_a ON guest_links (a)
CREATE INDEX ix_guest_links_b ON guest_links (b)

CREATE TABLE room_connections (
	a VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	b VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (a, b), 
	FOREIGN KEY(a) REFERENCES planning_resources (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(b) REFERENCES planning_resources (id)
)


CREATE TABLE planning_rules (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	severity VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	side VARCHAR(8), 
	tag VARCHAR(40), 
	parameters JSONB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE pending_changes (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	owner_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	warnings JSONB NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)


CREATE TABLE plan_changes (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	parent UUID, 
	actor_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	before JSONB NOT NULL, 
	after JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)


CREATE TABLE allocation_runs (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	owner_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	snapshot JSONB NOT NULL, 
	result JSONB, 
	lease_until TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_allocation_runs_status ON allocation_runs (status)

CREATE TABLE meal_attendance (
	guest_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	day DATE NOT NULL, 
	meal VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	location VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	planned BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	actual BOOLEAN, 
	inclusion VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (guest_id, day, meal, location), 
	FOREIGN KEY(guest_id) REFERENCES guests (id)
)


CREATE TABLE billing_settings (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	guest_meals JSONB NOT NULL, 
	second_extra_paise INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE hotel_charge_days (
	day DATE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (day)
)


CREATE TABLE bill_snapshots (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	actor_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	data JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE guest_presence (guest_id UUID NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES guests(id), arrived_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, departed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE)
CREATE TABLE function_events (id UUID NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, day DATE NOT NULL, side VARCHAR(8))
CREATE TABLE event_attendance (event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES function_events(id), guest_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES guests(id), planned BOOLEAN NOT NULL, actual BOOLEAN, PRIMARY KEY(event_id,guest_id))
